input.subject: Buyer needs 3BR co-op in Park Slope / Prospect Heights <$1.9M
input.bodyText:
Good morning network,

I have a lovely young family that just outgrew their rental. They are pre-approved and ready to move.

Criteria:
- 3 bed (or a real 2BR+home office they can convert)
- Park Slope or Prospect Heights, walk to the park a big plus
- Co-op is fine, low maintenance preferred, pet-friendly building (they have a dog)
- Budget up to $1.9M
- Elevator not required, but no 5th-floor walk-ups please

Zoned for good schools is the whole point of the move. If you have something coming soon, I'd love a look before it lists. Co-broke of course.

Thanks,
Ellen Vasquez
Corcoran | Brooklyn
